forbidden_overfitting_rule.text: Do not change scoring weights, valuation knobs, or automated policies on fewer than 30 non-test, non-synthetic, human-graded eligible outcomes in the same process_version. Holdout required before production weight change. One-case luck is not signal.

recommended_adjustment.detail: Do not adjust models on synthetic outcomes.
